reviews.name: Preenu Jacob
reviews.quote: Would like to thank Heaven event planner for their excellent services. Food was very tasty and delicious. Thank you for your team effort especially a word of Thanks to Elvin Thomas. Keep up the good work. Well done. So happy with your dedication

reviews.name: Maria Roy
reviews.quote: From the very beginning, the Heaven’s team impressed me with their professionalism, creativity, and commitment to excellence. Their leaders, staff, and entire support team were incredibly prompt, answering all my questions and doubts with patience and expertise.

reviews.name: Alin Mary Abraham
reviews.quote: I had the pleasure of working with Heavens Event Planners and I can confidently say that they are top-notch in the event planning industry. Mr.Elvin truly goes above and beyond to ensure every event is executed flawlessly.His passion and dedication to his clients are evident in every interaction.
